text: Underway in this round-robin clash.
Robodinho signals intent to claim the opening touch from the centre spot.
Robodinho slips the magenta ball straight through the middle, clean through on goal with nobody in front!
Corner ram hammers it back out.
Spark loses footing and drops down.
A clumsy mix-up in the final third as Robodinho clatters into teammate Griezmatronn, sending both tumbling onto the surface.
Robodinho breaks clear down the left touchline, with the goal completely exposed ahead!
Robodinho marches down the wing.
Flash FC are penned back completely.
Push-panel fires it back inside.
Robodinho puts in a heavy challenge in the defensive third, leaving Flash sprawling across the turf.
Flash tumbles to the deck again.
GOAL! Robodinho turns it in from close range on the left channel to make it Synthetic Athletic 1, Gemini Flash FC 0!
Robodinho calls to work the rebound.
Agonisingly close right in front of the goal mouth, drifting just a metre wide of the target!
Robodinho marches steadily up the pitch over twenty-six seconds, driving all the way into the goal mouth.
GOAL! Griezmatronn pounces point-blank in the goal mouth to double the advantage! Synthetic Athletic lead 2-0!
Another close shave on the right flank, whistling just inches past the upright!
Synthetic Athletic maintain absolute control, pinning the blue shirts inside their own third.
Griezmatronn radios over that the ball has wedged tight against the perimeter wall.
GOAL! Robodinho pokes it home from point-blank range right on the line! It is Synthetic Athletic 3, Gemini Flash FC 0!
Robodinho is clear on goal once again!
Just wide from long range!
GOAL! Robodinho makes no mistake this time, firing in from close range! Synthetic Athletic 4, Gemini Flash FC 0!
Robodinho charges straight up the middle into shooting range.
GOAL! Griezmatronn slots it home! Synthetic Athletic lead 5-0!
Non-stop pressure from the red shirts here, utterly monopolising territory in the attacking third while Flash FC struggle to regroup.
Robodinho informs Griezmatronn that they are wrestling the ball clear from the right-hand boards.
Robodinho confirms possession is secure back in defence, rolling away from the rebound panel.
GOAL! Robodinho strikes again from right in front! It is Synthetic Athletic 6, Gemini Flash FC 0!
Inches wide of the post!
GOAL! Griezmatronn bundles it over the line point-blank! That makes it 7-0 to Synthetic Athletic!
The halftime whistle sounds on a completely one-sided affair. Synthetic Athletic lead Gemini Flash FC 7-0 at the break.
Griezmatronn drives straight down the centre.
Straight back on the front foot, keeping Gemini Flash FC pinned deep in their half.
GOAL! Robodinho taps in from the doorstep! Synthetic Athletic make it 8-0!
Robodinho radios across to say they are levering the magenta ball off the right touchline boards.
Robodinho alerts Griezmatronn that the ball is successfully unpinned from the perimeter wall.
Robodinho spots the open lane and pushes clean through on goal from deep within the defensive third!
Robodinho surges forward into the attacking zone.
Narrowly wide of the target!
GOAL! Robodinho converts the rebound on the doorstep! Synthetic Athletic lead 9-0!
Griezmatronn powers right down the middle.
GOAL! Griezmatronn rolls it into the net! Synthetic Athletic hit double figures, 10-0!
Robodinho stumbles over in the centre circle, but the self-righting servos kick in immediately to recover.
Robodinho darts toward the goal.
GOAL! Robodinho tucks it away from close range! Synthetic Athletic make it 11-0!
Robodinho breaks clear once more with only empty space ahead!
Robodinho secures it near corner.
Just misses the mark from point-blank range, rolling a metre wide of the open frame!
A brief pause as Spark hovers over the ball in midfield. Flash FC conceded nine to AFC Fable yesterday and have found no relief today.
Griezmatronn pushes the ball through the centre of the pitch as the final seconds tick away.
Fires just wide of the right post!
Full time: Synthetic Athletic 11, Gemini Flash FC 0. Up next: Real Machina face AFC Fable.
